svg.aria-label: Octuma quantizes language models to 4 bits in four steps: calibrate, quantize, evaluate and export. Qwen2.5-3B goes from 6.18 GB in FP16 to 2.40 GB in INT4, 2.57x smaller, losing 2.43% of quality.
svg.title: Octuma — 6.18 GB → 2.40 GB, +2.43%
svg.text: Run them on modest laptops and Android phones.
Qwen2.5-3B, measured inside llama.cpp · wikitext-2, 20 windows of 2048 tokens
